skill.name: Write DataStream to Sink
skill.description: Output a DataStream to an external system (file, console, or custom sink). Use this to persist or display final results after all transformations.
skill.skill_body:
Call sink methods on a finalized DataStream to write results to an external system. Common sink operations include writeAsText(path) for file output and print() for console output. The sink is attached to the DataStream and executes when the job runs.

## Objective

Persist or output stream results
## Applicable Signals

- All transformations on DataStream are complete
- Results are ready for persistence or display

## Contraindications

- Still performing transformations on the DataStream
- Intermediate DataStream not yet finalized

## Workflow Steps

- Obtain a finalized DataStream after all transformations
- Select appropriate sink method (writeAsText, print, or custom sink)
- Call sink method on DataStream with required parameters
- Sink is now attached; data will be written upon job execution

## Constraints

- Sink must be attached before calling execute() on StreamExecutionEnvironment
- Only one sink operation per DataStream branch unless explicitly branched

## Cautions

- Sink operations are terminal; no further transformations can be applied downstream
- File paths must be valid and writable by the execution environment

## Output Contract

- Sink is configured and attached to DataStream; data will be written to the specified destination upon job execution via execute() or executeAsync().

## Example Executions

### Example 1

- Input: DataStream[String] containing processed log entries
- Output: Sink attached; entries written to file upon execution
- Notes: writeAsText(path: String) writes each element as a line

### Example 2

- Input: DataStream[Int] containing aggregated metrics
- Output: Sink attached; metrics printed to console upon execution
- Notes: print() outputs to stdout for debugging or monitoring
